limitations: Resource projections are estimates, not upper bounds. History lengths, episode/opponent distribution, full replay occupancy, allocator behavior, and checkpoint transient buffers may change usage. Guards enforce actual RSS, system RAM and disk headroom.
projection_formula: Observed journal and action-log bytes per valid decision *250000 +250 maximum-sized observed resume checkpoints +11 observed-size snapshots. Conservative projection doubles journal/action rates and adds 64 MiB telemetry allowance.
